test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: As of June 2023, which of the following is India’s largest airport in terms of total passengers?

options.text: Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose International Airport
Chhatrapati Shivaji International Airport of Mumbai

solution:
The correct answer is __**Indira Gandhi International Airport**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indira Gandhi International Airport** is currently the largest airport in India in terms of total passengers as of June 2023.
 
• Located in New Delhi, it serves as a major hub for both domestic and international flights.
 
• The airport is named after Indira Gandhi, the former Prime Minister of India.
 
• It has consistently ranked among the top airports in the world for passenger traffic and services.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indira Gandhi International Airport** has several terminals, with Terminal 3 being one of the largest in the country.
 
• The airport is operated by the Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL), a consortium led by GMR Group.
 
• It has won numerous awards for its service quality and infrastructure.
 
• The airport is a key gateway for international travelers coming to India and plays a crucial role in the country's aviation sector.
